meta.title: Aomark Listings legacy basename upgrade QA
meta.description: Upgrades the exact 3.5.1 package with its historical main filename to the exact 3.5.3 package and verifies canonical activation migration.
meta.author: aomark

steps.code: <?php $hashes = [ 'old' => hash_file( 'sha256', '/tmp/aomark-old/aomark-listings-3.5.1-wporg-final-20260731.zip' ), 'new' => hash_file( 'sha256', '/tmp/aomark-new/aomark-listings.zip' ) ]; if ( ! hash_equals( '0181d246cf09cb6a56abe1e74bc3936ec896008d8800417e76d1b92bcb80b20e', (string) $hashes['old'] ) || ! hash_equals( '04d3aed041160c68ea958ed92de1c5ad4ce06467031f5d867ec2a2900146c0f8', (string) $hashes['new'] ) ) { throw new RuntimeException( 'Exact ZIP checksum precondition failed: ' . json_encode( $hashes ) ); }

<?php require '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; $active = (array) get_option( 'active_plugins', [] ); $models = get_option( 'aomark_listings_models', '__aomark_listings_missing__' ); if ( ! defined( 'AOMARK_LISTINGS_VERSION' ) || '3.5.1' !== AOMARK_LISTINGS_VERSION || ! in_array( 'aomark-listings/aomark-real-estate.php', $active, true ) || ! is_array( $models ) ) { throw new RuntimeException( 'Exact 3.5.1 legacy activation precondition failed.' ); } update_option( 'aomark_listings_legacy_models_hash', hash( 'sha256', maybe_serialize( $models ) ), false );
